identity.focus_intro: These projects explore three connected engineering problems. Each one links to the implementation so you can inspect the decisions, boundaries and code.
identity.focus_title: A clearer path from code to delivery.
identity.headline: Software. Infrastructure. Connected.
identity.intro: From a working application to a repeatable delivery path. Explore my public engineering lab across interfaces, networks and services.
identity.name: Jenya

projects.boundary: Desired-state definitions in an engineering lab; no running cluster is implied.
projects.description: Argo CD and Kustomize definitions connect applications, networking and observability. Separate development and smoke roots make the intended environments readable in Git.
projects.focus_detail: Express the desired environment in Git, with explicit application and platform boundaries.
projects.problem: How do application and platform changes share one reviewable delivery path?
projects.title: Deployment, made explicit.

projects.boundary: Provisioning code and workflows; no currently running environment or billing guarantee is claimed.
projects.description: Terraform provisioning and Argo CD bootstrap describe the route from cloud resources to application delivery. Bounded smoke and cleanup workflows make the lifecycle explicit.
projects.focus_detail: Keep provisioning, bootstrap and cleanup steps visible instead of relying on undocumented setup.
projects.problem: How do you make environment setup easier to repeat and inspect?
projects.title: Infrastructure, repeatable.

projects.boundary: Application code in an engineering lab; no hosted commercial service or customer results are claimed.
projects.description: The app-poly-gitops lab includes a standalone browser UI for projects and chat alongside this FastAPI service for project conversations, stored transcripts and telemetry. GitOps delivery is defined in the related infrastructure repositories.
projects.focus_detail: Connect API behavior, conversation persistence and telemetry in one inspectable backend.
projects.problem: How do browser interactions connect to chat APIs and application state?
projects.title: AI chat, from UI to API.
